Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

The CScan form is used to scan the cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. You can access this screen by clicking the 'CScan' button from the OP service billing screen. Mandatory fields are marked in red, and you can enter the file number manually or select it using the nearby button. After entering the file number, you can add documents by clicking the 'Scan' button or the 'CScan' button for cards. All attached documents can be viewed by clicking the 'VScan' button, and you can allocate cash and credit schemes to patients using the 'Credit' and 'Cash' buttons. For payments, click the 'Save' button to generate the service bill, and a pop-up will show the payable amount details. Payments can be made using cash or card, with options for credit or debit cards. Here are some relevant images for your reference:

![CScan Form](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114401.png)
![VScan Form](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114139.png)
![Credit Scheme Allocation](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114430.png)
